purpose: Test one rank-only, bounded correction for redundant BM25/dense evidence inside the existing Stage-A retrieval term while preserving every other protected policy and runtime contract.
hypothesis: A submodular discount for globally redundant cross-route support will improve early rank and turn utility across generator-separated data without losing any protected-baseline hit, while exact baseline behavior is retained whenever route evidence is empty, single-route, disjoint, identical-order after normalization, disabled, malformed, or faulted.

alternatives_considered_before_freeze.reason: Product diversity does not identify customer answerability; Phase 8 already falsified the available separation proxy.

alternatives_considered_before_freeze.direction: raw BM25 and cosine score-entropy weighting
alternatives_considered_before_freeze.reason: The route score scales are uncalibrated and would widen portability and numerical contracts.
The public-tested Phase 10 candidate is consumed and may not be tuned or rerun from its outcome.
It is bounded, reversible, data-independent, score-scale-free, and adds no route or model work.

allowed_design_inputs: current source, tests, API and retrieval contracts
aggregate-only historical metrics and fixed health counters
docs/phase11_dataset_audit.json aggregate hashes, schema, duplicate counts, and overlap counts
generic rank-fusion, submodularity, redundancy, monotonicity, and bounded-arithmetic principles
hand-written synthetic intent states, route IDs, ranks, candidate text, failures, and cache states
forbidden_design_debug_or_tuning_inputs: public, development, validation, or hidden row content
messages, profiles, targets, products, product IDs, ranks, trajectories, hits, misses, per-case fingerprints, or small cells from evaluated datasets
scenario-specific, category-specific, product-specific, attribute-specific, turn-specific, or session-specific rules
catalog-derived frequencies, target membership, label-linked route evidence, or outcome-calibrated constants
multiple formulas or thresholds followed by development, validation, or public selection
post-outcome repair, threshold change, formula change, cue change, or rerun of a consumed candidate

frozen_components.query_renderers: exact Phase 9 dense and lexical renderers
frozen_components.route_execution: one BM25 Top-100 and one BGE-small dense Top-100 per fresh search
frozen_components.candidate_union: exact unique union of protected route IDs

candidate_change.scope: Replace only the normalized additive route-evidence scalar consumed by Stage A with the frozen redundancy-corrected scalar. Preserve route execution, candidate union, clause satisfaction, beta, profile composition, and all dialogue behavior.
candidate_change.policy_switch: one immutable non-default RankingPolicy value; starter.Agent remains Phase 9 until promotion

inputs.B: unique ordered BM25 IDs, length n_B at most 100
inputs.D: unique ordered dense IDs, length n_D at most 100
inputs.F: unique fused candidate IDs equal exactly set(B) union set(D), length at most 200
inputs.weights: finite RouteWeights w_B,w_D in (0,1] with w_B+w_D exactly 1 under the protected validation tolerance

mathematical_contract.redundancy: rho = 0 when min(n_B,n_D)=0; otherwise rho = |set(B) intersect set(D)| / min(n_B,n_D)
claims: for fixed route sets, u_i is monotonic in each nonnegative route contribution
swapping route lists together with their weights leaves every u_i unchanged
one empty route or disjoint routes yields exact protected normalized additive evidence
identical ordered routes yield exact protected normalized route evidence
the negative cross-route term is a redundancy heuristic, not a calibrated target probability
mathematical_contract.floating_point_policy: Use ordinary deterministic Python float arithmetic only after validating bounded integer ranks and RouteWeights. No epsilon, clipping, data-dependent tolerance, randomized rounding, or platform-specific branch may affect ordering.
mathematical_contract.invalid_or_nonfinite_input: Return the already computed exact Phase 9 result and record one fixed aggregate scoring-fallback status; normal evaluation requires this count to be zero.

bounded_runtime_contract.complexity: O(n_B+n_D+n_F) time and O(n_B+n_D) transient references

focused_cells: empty routes, one empty route, singleton routes, disjoint routes, partially overlapping routes, identical sets with identical and differing orders, and one-route-subset cases
route lengths 0,1,2,10,99,100 and fused lengths through 200
coefficient, raw evidence, normalized evidence, beta, and final score boundary values
symmetry under route and weight swap, monotonicity, deterministic ties, and complete-permutation preservation
all missing, all matching, partial, unanimous, and conflicting synthetic clause evidence
neutral, active, represented, constant, and faulting profile residuals
fresh search, exact cache reuse, dependency change, backend identity change, reset, interleaved sessions, and top_k zero
malformed types, duplicates, route-union mismatch, oversized sequences, nonfinite values, incomplete documents, route faults, reranker faults, cache faults, and fallback output
deterministic_test_contract.exhaustive_small_oracle: Enumerate every pair of unique ordered routes over a four-ID universe through length four and fixed valid weights; verify bounds, symmetry, exact cells, set preservation, and replay.
required_exact_baseline_cells: routes identical in order after normalized evidence
ordinary API and response behavior outside candidate ranking
required_invariants: candidate ranked IDs are a complete unique permutation of protected fused IDs
queries, route weights, route calls, candidate documents, clause satisfaction, beta, questions, messages, slates, usage, and profile state are unchanged
candidate replay state, output, slate, cache, and aggregate health are exact
protected Phase 7 and Phase 9 oracle digests remain exact
starter.Agent remains at the protected hash before promotion

development.rule: Exclude every released-public content fingerprint, then keep the first ordinal for each remaining content fingerprint.

validation.rule: Exclude every released-public content fingerprint, then keep the first ordinal for each remaining content fingerprint.
validation.sealed_until: development passes every gate with candidate source and implementation lock unchanged

public_confirmation.access: one final frozen confirmation only after development and validation both pass

preparation_order: test, performance, promotion, and rollback contract
complete unit suite and protected oracles
execution_protocol.after_failed_suite: Stop. Do not inspect failures, change source/formula/constants, rerun, access the next suite, or access public confirmation.

paired_inference.bootstrap: scenario-stratified paired resampling with replacement within each fixed scenario stratum

publication.rejection: append aggregate-only docs/phase12_results.json; keep benchmarks/phase9.json official

rollback.trigger: Any source, test, oracle, formula, quality, transition, confidence, exactness, call, fault, fallback, API, privacy, performance, memory, or reproducibility gate fails.
rollback.action: Reject the candidate, leave or restore starter.Agent to the protected SHA-256 without destructive git operations, disable the candidate policy, retain aggregate-only evidence, and do not rerun the consumed suite.
